title: Capstone: Library Management System
description:
```
=== City Library ===
1) Add book  2) Register member  3) Borrow  4) Return  5) Search  6) Overdue report  0) Quit
```
requirements: Classes: `Book` (ISBN, title, author, year, available), `Member` (id, name, borrowed list, max 3), `Library` (owns vectors of both)
`Date` class from project 4 for due dates; overdue fines
All invariants enforced (can't borrow unavailable book, can't exceed limit)
One `.h`/`.cpp` pair per class; clean `main.cpp` menu (add files with the New file button above the explorer, or right-click in it)
Stretch: save/load to a text file (preview of [[10.06 Files and Filesystem]])
